summary: The noun עַיִט names a bird of prey. In Genesis 15:11 it denotes the birds that descend on the carcasses.

senses.definition: A bird that takes prey or feeds on carrion. The singular can denote several such birds together.

evidence.note: הָעַיִט descends on the carcasses. The plural אֹתָם refers to the birds Abram drives away.

note: Root (2026-11-21): Kept under the hollow root עיט: scripture's verb עִיט "swoop, dart greedily" (1Sa 15:19 וַתַּעַט; 1Sa 25:14 וַיָּעַט) is the bird of prey's own action.
